The pencil-on-hover is tidy, but it makes me a little nervous: it only shows up when I mouse over, so it's invisible until I go looking, and if I were ever on a touch screen there's nothing to hover. I'd rather the way in always be visible.

So here's my pick: I'll go with the **"•••" menu** (option B). Here's my reasoning — editing isn't the only thing I'll eventually want to do to a single bookmark. I know I'll want to delete ones I don't need and tuck away old ones I want to keep but not see all the time. That little menu feels like the natural home for all of those, editing included, without cluttering the card. As long as it's always visible (not hover-only), that's the one I want.
